findings.body: Raise: Not done. A normal queued `forge work` run can print the machine-lane wait message before this Fast-unavailable notice. The notice is emitted only after Codex selects a model here, while `machine.join` prints its wait message earlier (`src/forge/machine.py:159`). A split-worker run that falls back from Claude also prints the Claude building and fallback messages first (`src/forge/worker.py:111,209`). In both cases, the run's first stdout line does not explain that Fast was wanted but unavailable. The first-line test covers neither queue contention nor fallback.
